#### Setup PATH

```{r setting wd, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
WORKDIR <- Sys.getenv("CFMD_BENCH_WORKDIR", unset = getwd())
setwd(WORKDIR)
```

#### Methods and Libraries

```{r sourcing pkgs, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
options(repos = c(CRAN = "https://cloud.r-project.org"))

# Method selection 
all_methods <- list(
  glmnet = "GLM elastic net",
  kknn = "K-Nearest Neighbor",
  lda = "Linear Discriminant Analysis",
  mlp = "Multi-layer Perceptron",
  naive_bayes = "Naive Bayes",
  ranger = "Random Forest",
  svm = "Support Vector Machine",
  tabpfn = "TabPFN",
  xgboost = "XGBoost"
)

pick_method <- c("ranger", "xgboost") #example

# resolve selection
methods <- if (identical(pick_method, "all")) all_methods else {
  miss <- setdiff(pick_method, names(all_methods))
  if (length(miss)) stop(sprintf("Unknown methods: %s.", paste(miss, collapse=", ")))
  all_methods[pick_method]
}

needs_mlr3torch <- "mlp" %in% names(methods)
needs_tabpfn <- "tabpfn" %in% names(methods)

if (needs_mlr3torch && needs_tabpfn) {
  stop("Conflict: 'mlp' (mlr3torch) and 'tabpfn' (reticulate/Conda) cannot run in the same R session. ",
       "Remove one from 'pick_method' and rerun.")
}

cat("Methods selected:\n"); print(methods)

# Package sourcing 
is_installed <- function(pkg) pkg %in% rownames(installed.packages())

# Install GitHub packages once
if (!is_installed("remotes")) install.packages("remotes")
if (!is_installed("mlr3extralearners")) remotes::install_github("mlr-org/mlr3extralearners@*release")

if (!requireNamespace("pacman", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("pacman")

base_pkgs <- c(
  "callr","coin","compositions","conflicted","cowplot","data.table","emoa",
  "factoextra","FactoMineR","farff","fastVoteR","FSelectorRcpp","future",
  "future.apply","httr","jsonlite","kknn","iml","magrittr","mlr3filters","mlr3fselect","mlr3hyperband",
  "mlr3learners","mlr3oml","mlr3pipelines","mlr3tuning",
  "mlr3tuningspaces","mlr3viz","paradox","parallel","patchwork","plotly",
  "progressr","ranger","scales","smotefamily","stabm","tidyverse","Rtsne","vegan",
  "zCompositions","wordcloud","wordcloud2"
)

torch_pkgs   <- if (needs_mlr3torch) c("mlr3torch") else character()
tabpfn_pkgs  <- if (needs_tabpfn) c("reticulate","mlr3extralearners") else "mlr3extralearners"

pkgs <- unique(c(base_pkgs, torch_pkgs, tabpfn_pkgs))
do.call(pacman::p_load, c(as.list(pkgs), install = TRUE))

# Solve known conflicts
conflict_prefer("select", "dplyr")
conflict_prefer("filter", "dplyr")
conflict_prefer("rename", "dplyr")
conflict_prefer("mutate", "dplyr")
conflict_prefer("first", "dplyr")
conflict_prefer("var", "compositions")
conflict_prefer("progress", "httr")

# Environment setup guard
if (needs_tabpfn) {
  
  # Load HF token (so Python can access gated TabPFN models)
  if (file.exists(".Renviron")) readRenviron(".Renviron")
  token <- Sys.getenv("HF_TOKEN", unset = NA)
  if (is.na(token) || token == "") {
    stop("HF_TOKEN missing. Define it in .Renviron or system environment before running TabPFN.")
  }
  Sys.setenv(HF_TOKEN = token)  # ensure it is exported to Python

  # Configure Conda / reticulate environment
  Sys.setenv(PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF = "expandable_segments:True")
  TABPFN_ENV_NAME <- Sys.getenv("TABPFN_ENV_NAME", unset = "tabpfn-gpu")
  TABPFN_CONDA_ROOT <- Sys.getenv("TABPFN_CONDA_ROOT", unset = Sys.getenv("CONDA_PREFIX"))
  Sys.setenv(RETICULATE_MINICONDA_PATH = TABPFN_CONDA_ROOT)
  use_condaenv(TABPFN_ENV_NAME, required = TRUE)
  
  # Sanity checks
  chk <- list(
    torch    = reticulate::py_module_available("torch"),
    sklearn  = reticulate::py_module_available("sklearn"),
    tabpfn   = reticulate::py_module_available("tabpfn")
  )
  if (!all(unlist(chk))) {
    stop(sprintf(
      "Missing Python modules in 'tabpfn-env': %s",
      paste(names(chk)[!unlist(chk)], collapse = ", ")
    ))
  }
  reticulate::py_config()
}

if (needs_mlr3torch) {
  if (!torch::torch_is_installed()) {
    message("Installing R torch backend..."); torch::install_torch()
  }
  if (!torch::cuda_is_available()) message("CUDA not available. R torch will use CPU.")
}
```

#### Set Parameters

```{r settings, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Set general parameters for execution

# Reduce verbosity of mlr3 logs
lgr::get_logger("mlr3")$set_threshold("off")
lgr::get_logger("bbotk")$set_threshold("off")
# lgr::get_logger("mlr3")$set_threshold("error")
# lgr::get_logger("bbotk")$set_threshold("error")
# lgr::get_logger("mlr3")$set_threshold("warn")
# lgr::get_logger("bbotk")$set_threshold("warn")
# lgr::get_logger("mlr3")$set_threshold("info")
# lgr::get_logger("bbotk")$set_threshold("info")

# Set random seed for reproducibility
seed = 42
set.seed(seed)

# Resampling settings
kfold = 10 #k-fold
repeats = 5 #Apply repeated k-fold on small datasets

# Set number of CPU threads for parallel computation
num_threads = detectCores()  #Detects available cores dynamically

# Set the number of parallel jobs beased on kfold
num_jobs = kfold  #Manually set number of threads

# Set future.apply to handle large data in parallel (up to 2GB memory limit)
options(future.globals.maxSize = 2 * 1024^3)

# Display progress bar if possible
handlers(global = TRUE)

# Time for an algorithm to run before a terminator will kill the tuning instance, in minutes.
term_min = 20

# Source GitHub token
GITHUB_TOKEN <- Sys.getenv("GITHUB_TOKEN")
stopifnot(nzchar(GITHUB_TOKEN))

# Repo url
base_url <- "https://api.github.com/repos/SegataLab/cFMD/contents/cFMD_data"

# Completeness threshold (percent)
completeness_threshold <- 99

# Define filtering thresholds
min_samples_per_class <- 25 #Minimum samples required to keep a class
samples_to_keep <- 1 #Ratio of samples to keep

# User-defined SMOTE parameter: set "none" to skip, leave empty for automatic assignment
smote = ""  # Options: "smote", "blsmote", "adasyn", "none", or ""

# Feature filtering (FALSE|"minimal"|"varcor"|"infogain")
filtering = "minimal"

# Feature selection (TRUE|FALSE)
selecting = TRUE

# Fast tuning (TRUE|FALSE). Might fail with small datasets
fast_tuning = TRUE

# Set the final graph learner encapsulation with a featureless fallback
# Continue the pipeline no matter what (or almost) but no intermediate results will be stored, i.e. in .result
learner_fallback = FALSE

# Dataset ID and version
ds = "cFMD"
ver = "v1.3.0"

# Define a variable to use as target. Use either category, type, or subtype.
target <- "category"

run_date <- ""  # Set to e.g. "2025-12-25" to use a specific dir, or "" for today

# Define directory for saving tuned learners and instances
if (run_date == "" || is.na(run_date)) {
  run_date <- as.character(Sys.Date())
}
save_dir <- paste(run_date, ds, ver, "saved_learners", sep = "_")

if (!dir.exists(save_dir)) {
  dir.create(save_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  message("Created new directory: ", save_dir)
} else {
  message("Using existing directory: ", save_dir)
}

# Cache root for downloaded TSVs
cache_dir <- file.path("cache_cFMD", ver)
dir.create(cache_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
manifest_path <- file.path(cache_dir, paste0(ds, "_", ver, "_manifest", ".rds"))
manifest <- if (file.exists(manifest_path)) readRDS(manifest_path) else list()
```

#### Import Data

```{r import, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Helper: build GitHub Contents API URLs pinned to a ref (tag/commit)
cfmd_ref <- ver  # the code was tested on v1.3.0

gh_contents_url <- function(path, ref = cfmd_ref) {
  paste0(
    "https://api.github.com/repos/SegataLab/cFMD/contents/",
    path,
    "?ref=",
    ref
  )
}

# Define a download helper
get_projects <- function(base_url) {
  resp <- GET(base_url, add_headers(Authorization = paste("token", GITHUB_TOKEN)))
  stop_for_status(resp)
  cont <- content(resp, as = "parsed")
  vapply(cont, function(x) x$name, character(1))
}

# Download only if sha changed, otherwise read from disk
read_profile_cached <- function(project) {
  file_path <- sprintf("cFMD_data/%s/%s_taxonomic_profiles.tsv", project, project)
  api_url   <- gh_contents_url(file_path)

  meta <- GET(api_url, add_headers(Authorization = paste("token", GITHUB_TOKEN)))
  if (status_code(meta) != 200) {
    message(sprintf("Skipped (API %s): %s", status_code(meta), project))
    return(NULL)
  }
  info <- content(meta, as = "parsed")
  sha  <- info$sha
  raw  <- info$download_url

  local_tsv <- file.path(cache_dir, paste0(project, "_taxonomic_profiles.tsv"))

  need_download <- TRUE
  if (file.exists(local_tsv) && !is.null(manifest[[project]]) && identical(manifest[[project]], sha)) {
    need_download <- FALSE
  }

  if (need_download) {
    # atomic write to avoid partial files
    tmp <- paste0(local_tsv, ".tmp")
    resp <- GET(raw, write_disk(tmp, overwrite = TRUE), progress())
    if (status_code(resp) != 200) {
      message(sprintf("Skipped (download %s): %s", status_code(resp), project))
      if (file.exists(tmp)) unlink(tmp)
      return(NULL)
    }
    file.rename(tmp, local_tsv)
    manifest[[project]] <<- sha
    saveRDS(manifest, manifest_path)
    message("Downloaded: ", project)
  } else {
    message("Cached: ", project)
  }

  # robust read
  df <- tryCatch({
    # Detect malformed header pattern:
    #   line 1: <TAB><project>	<project>	... (duplicate project name, empty first cell)
    #   line 2: sample	<project__SRS...>	...
    # In this case, promote line 2 to header and drop line 1+2 from data.
    lines2 <- readLines(local_tsv, n = 2, warn = FALSE)

    weird_header <- length(lines2) >= 2 &&
      # line 1 often starts with a tab (empty first cell) and/or repeats the project name
      grepl("^\t", lines2[1]) &&
      grepl("^sample\t", lines2[2])

    if (weird_header) {
      tmp <- read_tsv(local_tsv, col_names = FALSE, col_types = cols(), show_col_types = FALSE)

      # Row 2 contains true column names: 'sample', '<project__SRS...>', ...
      new_names <- as.character(tmp[2, ])
      tmp <- tmp[-c(1, 2), , drop = FALSE]
      names(tmp) <- new_names

      tmp %>% rename(Taxon = 1)
    } else {
      read_tsv(local_tsv, col_types = cols(), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
        rename(Taxon = 1)
    }
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Failed to parse: ", project, " - ", e$message)
    NULL
  })
  df
}

# Load and merge data
closeAllConnections()

# IMPORTANT: base_url must already include ?ref=ver, e.g.
# base_url <- gh_contents_url("cFMD_data")
projects <- get_projects(base_url)

batch_size <- 10
batches <- split(projects, ceiling(seq_along(projects) / batch_size))
profile_list <- list()

for (batch in batches) {
  message("Processing batch: ", paste(batch, collapse = ", "))
  batch_profiles <- map(batch, read_profile_cached) %>% compact()
  profile_list <- c(profile_list, batch_profiles)
  Sys.sleep(2)  # gentle on API
  closeAllConnections()
}

message("Loaded ", length(profile_list), " profiles out of ", length(projects), " projects.")
if (length(profile_list) == 0) stop("No profiles loaded.")

merged_profiles <- reduce(profile_list, full_join, by = "Taxon")
message("Merged to ", nrow(merged_profiles), " rows × ", ncol(merged_profiles), " cols.")

# Robust split: metadata vs taxa rows (no hard-coded first N rows)
# Primary signal: Taxon label looks like a taxonomy string.
# In cFMD v1.3.x many taxa use rank prefixes (k__/p__/...) and '|' separators.
# Secondary signal: rows are numeric-like across sample columns.
sample_cols <- setdiff(names(merged_profiles), "Taxon")

taxon_chr <- as.character(merged_profiles$Taxon)

is_taxa_by_label <-
  grepl("^(?:[dkpcofgs]__|k__)", taxon_chr) | # rank prefixes
  grepl("\\|", taxon_chr) | # taxonomy separators in cFMD
  grepl(";", taxon_chr, fixed = TRUE)

num_ok_frac <- apply(merged_profiles[sample_cols], 1, function(r) {
  mean(!is.na(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(r))))
})

is_taxa_by_numeric <- num_ok_frac > 0.9

# Accept taxa if EITHER signal fires (label-based is robust to mixed columns)
is_taxa <- is_taxa_by_label | is_taxa_by_numeric

metadata  <- merged_profiles[!is_taxa, , drop = FALSE]
taxa_only <- merged_profiles[ is_taxa, , drop = FALSE]

message("Taxa rows detected: ", nrow(taxa_only), " | metadata rows: ", nrow(metadata))

# Convert to numeric (excluding 'Taxon') and replace NAs with 0
if (nrow(taxa_only) == 0) stop("No taxa rows detected after merge (check input structure/ref).")

for (nm in sample_cols) {
  taxa_only[[nm]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(taxa_only[[nm]]))
  taxa_only[[nm]][is.na(taxa_only[[nm]])] <- 0
}

# Filter by completeness threshold (sum of taxa per sample)
column_sums <- colSums(taxa_only[sample_cols], na.rm = TRUE)
good_samples <- names(column_sums[column_sums >= completeness_threshold])

# Keep Taxon + good samples; handle edge cases
if (length(good_samples) == 0) stop("No samples meet completeness_threshold.")

filtered_taxa <- taxa_only[, c("Taxon", good_samples), drop = FALSE]
# Keep the same sample columns as filtered_taxa to make bind_rows safe
filtered_metadata <- metadata[, c("Taxon", good_samples), drop = FALSE]

# Ensure compatible column types for row-binding:
# metadata sample columns are character; taxa sample columns are numeric.
# Coerce taxa sample columns to character; convert back to numeric after transpose.
filtered_taxa <- filtered_taxa %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(good_samples), as.character))

# Recombine (metadata rows first, then taxa)
filtered_profiles <- bind_rows(filtered_metadata, filtered_taxa)

cat("Kept", length(good_samples), "samples with ≥", completeness_threshold, "% completeness.\n")

# Transpose to sample x features table
transposed_matrix <- t(filtered_profiles[-1])
transposed_df <- as.data.frame(transposed_matrix)

# Column names come from Taxon values; make them unique to avoid silent renames later
colnames(transposed_df) <- make.unique(as.character(filtered_profiles$Taxon))

# Capture sample ids from the transpose rownames (these are the original sample column names)
sample_ids <- rownames(transposed_df)
if (is.null(sample_ids)) {
  sample_ids <- as.character(seq_len(nrow(transposed_df)))
}

# If the metadata contains a column named 'sample', keep it but rename it to avoid collision
if ("sample" %in% names(transposed_df)) {
  transposed_df <- dplyr::rename(transposed_df, sample_meta = sample)
}

# Add explicit sample id column (never coerce this to numeric)
transposed_df <- tibble::as_tibble(transposed_df)
transposed_df$sample <- sample_ids

# Re-order the levels in each categorical factor (metadata only)
reorder_factor <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x) || is.factor(x)) {
    factor(x, levels = sort(unique(x)))
  } else {
    x
  }
}

meta_cols <- names(transposed_df)[!startsWith(names(transposed_df), "k__")]

tab_raw <- transposed_df %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(meta_cols), reorder_factor)
  )

# Plot samples whose taxa sum deviates from 100
# Assumes the intended scale is 0..100; adjust target to 1 if needed
column_sums_all <- colSums(taxa_only[sample_cols], na.rm = TRUE)

bad_samples <- names(column_sums_all)[abs(column_sums_all - 100) > 1e-3]
bad_sums <- column_sums_all[bad_samples]

project_names <- sapply(strsplit(bad_samples, "__"), `[`, 1)

bad_df <- data.frame(
  sample = bad_samples,
  Sum = as.numeric(bad_sums),
  Project = project_names
)

if (nrow(bad_df) > 0) {
  p <- ggplot(bad_df, aes(x = Sum, y = reorder(sample, Sum), text = paste("Project:", Project))) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    facet_wrap(~ Project, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(x = "Sum", y = "sample") +
    theme_minimal()

  ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
} else {
  message("All samples meet the completeness check (sum ~ 100).")
}
```

#### Pre-Process I

```{r pre-process, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# Convert to correct types and keep sample + target + microbial features
tab <- tab_raw %>% 
  mutate(across(starts_with("k__"), as.numeric)) %>% 
  mutate(
    !!as.symbol(target) := factor(
      !!as.symbol(target),
      levels = sort(unique(!!as.symbol(target)))
    )
  ) %>% 
  select(sample, !!as.symbol(target), starts_with("k__"))

# Rename target column
names(tab)[names(tab) == target] <- "target"

# Filter classes by minimum sample size
tab <- tab %>%
  group_by(target) %>%
  mutate(n = n()) %>%
  filter(n >= min_samples_per_class) %>%
  slice_sample(prop = samples_to_keep) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-n) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  droplevels()

# Define if the dataset is suitable for either binary or multi-class classification
# as.data.table(mlr_measures)
positive_class = ""

# Check number of unique classes in target variable and assign classification metrics accordingly
if (length(levels(as.factor(tab$target))) > 2) {
  dataset_attr = "multi-class"
  bmr_measures <- c("classif.acc", "classif.bacc", "classif.logloss")
  train_measures <- c("classif.bacc", "classif.logloss")
} else if (length(levels(as.factor(tab$target))) == 2) {
  dataset_attr = "binary"
  bmr_measures <- c("classif.acc", "classif.bacc", "classif.logloss",
                    "classif.precision", "classif.recall", "classif.specificity",
                    "classif.fbeta", "classif.auc", "classif.prauc")
  train_measures <- c("classif.bacc", "classif.logloss")

  # If positive_class is not predefined, assign the minority class
  if (positive_class == "") {
    counts <- table(tab$target)
    minority_class <- names(which.min(counts))
    positive_class <- minority_class
  }
} else {
  stop("The target column is neither binary nor multi-class. Please check!")
}

# Display classification type and suitable evaluation metrics
cat("\n", paste("The dataset is suitable for", dataset_attr, "classification."), "\n")
cat("\n", "Selected evaluation metrics:", paste(train_measures, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Re-shuffling samples randomly
tab %<>% rename_with(~ gsub("\\|", "_", .))
tab %<>% sample_frac(size = 1)
```

#### Visualize Data II

```{r inspecting data, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
df <- as_tibble(tab) %>% mutate(target = str_replace_all(target, "_", " "))

# Pick taxa columns
taxa_cols <- setdiff(names(df), "target")
old_names <- taxa_cols

# Shorten: prefer species tail, else genus tail, else keep
shorten_one <- function(n){
  if (grepl("s__", n)) return(sub(".*(s__.*)$", "\\1", n))
  if (grepl("g__", n)) return(sub(".*(g__.*)$", "\\1", n))
  n
}
new_names <- vapply(taxa_cols, shorten_one, character(1))

# Ensure uniqueness
new_names <- make.unique(new_names, sep = "_")

# Apply to df
names(df)[match(taxa_cols, names(df))] <- new_names

y  <- df$target
X <- df[ , !(names(df) %in% c("target", "sample"))]

# Optional downsample (keep y aligned)
if (nrow(X) > 10000) {
  idx <- sample(seq_len(nrow(X)), 1000)
  X <- X[idx, , drop = FALSE]
  y <- y[idx]
}

# Prevalence filter and zero-variance guard
prev <- colMeans(X > 0)
X <- X[, prev >= 0.05, drop = FALSE] # keep taxa present in ≥5% samples
if (ncol(X) == 0) stop("All features filtered out; lower the prevalence threshold.")
X <- X[, apply(X, 2, var) > 0, drop = FALSE]

# Zero replacement WITHOUT deletions
X0 <- zCompositions::cmultRepl(as.matrix(X),
                               label = 0,
                               method = "CZM",
                               z.warning = 1, # silence high-zero warnings
                               z.delete  = FALSE) # do not drop rows/cols

# CLR transform
X_clr <- compositions::clr(X0)

# PCA (on CLR)
pca <- prcomp(X_clr, scale. = TRUE)

# Scree plot of PCA variance
fviz_eig(pca, addlabels = TRUE)

# PCA plot  
scores <- data.frame(PC1 = pca$x[,1], PC2 = pca$x[,2], target = y)

ggplot(scores, aes(PC1, PC2, fill = target)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 5, colour = "white", stroke = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "turbo", name = "target") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "PCA on CLR-transformed abundances",
       x = paste0("PC1 (", round(100*summary(pca)$importance[2,1], 1), "%)"),
       y = paste0("PC2 (", round(100*summary(pca)$importance[2,2], 1), "%)"))

# Loadings contributions (top 10)
fviz_contrib(pca, choice = "var", axes = 1:2, top = 10)

# Elbow plot to select
cumulative_prop_var <- cumsum(pca$sdev ^ 2 / sum(pca$sdev ^ 2))

# Find number of components explaining 90% of variance
num_components <- which(cumulative_prop_var >= 0.9)[1]

# Print number of components
cat("Number of components explaining 90% of variance:",
    num_components,
    "\n")

# Create a data frame with the number of components and their cumulative proportion of variance explained
elbow_df <-
  data.frame(
    Num_Components = 1:length(cumulative_prop_var),
    Cumulative_Proportion_Var_Explained = cumulative_prop_var
  )

# Elbow plot
ggplot(elbow_df,
       aes(x = Num_Components, y = Cumulative_Proportion_Var_Explained)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = num_components,
    color = "dodgerblue3",
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1, length(cumulative_prop_var), 1)) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "Elbow plot of PCA components",
    subtitle = "Reference line: components explaining up to 90% variance",
    x = "Number of components",
    y = "Cumulative proportion of variance explained"
  )

# Get the PCA loading matrix
loadings <- pca$rotation

# Find the variable with highest absolute loading for each principal component
variables <- rownames(loadings)  # Get the variable names
max_loadings <-
  apply(abs(loadings), 2, function(x)
    variables[which.max(x)])

# Output the results
for (i in 1:ncol(loadings)) {
  cat(paste0("Most important variable for PC", i, ": ", max_loadings[i]),
      "\n")
}

# t-SNE (on CLR abundances)
perplexity <- pmin(30, floor((nrow(X_clr) - 1) / 3))  # safe, within 5–30 typical
ts <- Rtsne(
  X_clr,
  pca = TRUE,
  check_duplicates = FALSE,
  perplexity = perplexity,
  theta = 0.5,
  num_threads = 8
)

ts_df <- data.frame(tSNE1 = ts$Y[,1], tSNE2 = ts$Y[,2], target = y)

ggplot(ts_df, aes(tSNE1, tSNE2, fill = target)) +
  geom_point(
    shape = 21,
    size = 5,
    colour = "white",
    stroke = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "turbo", name = "target") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "t-SNE on CLR-transformed abundances") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14)
  )
```

#### Define Task

```{r task, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Basic cleanup
tab$sample <- trimws(as.character(tab$sample))

# Required columns are already standardized upstream
stopifnot("sample" %in% names(tab), "target" %in% names(tab))

# Optional diagnostics (only if duplicates exist)
if (anyDuplicated(tab$sample)) {
  dups <- tab$sample[duplicated(tab$sample)]
  message("Duplicated sample IDs: ", length(dups))
  print(head(unique(dups), 25))

  print(
    tab %>%
      filter(sample %in% unique(dups)) %>%
      arrange(sample) %>%
      select(sample, target) %>%
      head(30)
  )

  tab$sample_id <- make.unique(tab$sample)
  id_col <- "sample_id"
} else {
  id_col <- "sample"
}

# Build task with a stable primary key and remove it from features
stopifnot("sample" %in% names(tab), !anyDuplicated(tab$sample))
backend <- mlr3::as_data_backend(tab, primary_key = seq_len(nrow(tab)))  # integer
task <- mlr3::as_task_classif(backend, target = "target")

# Keep sample for reference, but not as a feature
task$set_col_roles("sample", roles = character())

# Split
split <- partition(task, ratio = 0.8)
task_train <- task$clone(deep = TRUE)$filter(split$train)
task_test  <- task$clone(deep = TRUE)$filter(split$test)

# Positive class (binary)
if (dataset_attr == "binary") {
  task$positive <- positive_class
  task_train$positive <- positive_class
  task_test$positive  <- positive_class
}

# Stratify
task$set_col_roles("target", c("target", "stratum"))
task_train$set_col_roles("target", c("target", "stratum"))
task_test$set_col_roles("target", c("target", "stratum"))
```

#### Pre-Process II

```{r preprocess, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Analyze Class Distribution
class_counts <- table(task_train$data()$target)
majority_class <- names(which.max(class_counts))
minority_class <- names(which.min(class_counts))
imbalance_ratio <- class_counts[majority_class] / class_counts[minority_class]

# Print class distribution information
cat("\nClass Distribution Analysis:\n")
print(class_counts)
cat("\nMajority Class:", majority_class, "with", class_counts[majority_class], "instances\n")
cat("Minority Class:", minority_class, "with", class_counts[minority_class], "instances\n")
cat("Imbalance Ratio:", round(imbalance_ratio, 2), ":", "1\n")

# Create dataframe for plotting
class_counts_df <- as.data.frame(class_counts)
colnames(class_counts_df) <- c("target", "count")

# Plot class distribution
ggplot(class_counts_df, aes(x = reorder(target, count, decreasing = TRUE), y = count, fill = target)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE) +  
  geom_text(aes(label = count), vjust = -0.5, size = 5, fontface = "bold") +  
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "turbo", name = "target") + 
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "Class Distribution",
    x = "Target Class",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

# Setup SMOTE Parameters
min_samples_per_class <- min_samples_per_class  # Minimum required samples per class for SMOTE
imbalance_threshold <- 1.5    # Only apply SMOTE if imbalance exceeds this

# Check if dataset qualifies for SMOTE
apply_smote <- imbalance_ratio > imbalance_threshold && all(class_counts >= min_samples_per_class)

# If smote is empty (""), decide automatically whether to apply it or not
if (smote == "") {
  smote <- if (apply_smote) "smote" else "none"
} 

# Ensure SMOTE is only set if `apply_smote` is TRUE
if (!apply_smote) {
  smote <- "none"  # Explicitly set SMOTE to "none" if the dataset is balanced
}

# Print final decision on SMOTE
cat("\nFinal SMOTE decision:", smote, "\n")

# Print a message if SMOTE was initially selected but later skipped
if (smote != "none" && !apply_smote) {
  cat("\nSMOTE was initially selected but is not needed for this dataset. No oversampling will be applied.\n")
}

# Initialize SMOTE pipeline as NULL
smote_pipe <- NULL

# Build Preprocessing Pipeline
preprocessing_pipe <- NULL

if (selecting) filtering = "minimal"

if (filtering == "varcor") {
  preprocessing_pipe <- ppl("robustify") %>>%
    po("filter", filter = flt("variance"), id = "variance_filter") %>>%
    po("filter", filter = flt("find_correlation"), method = "spearman", id = "correlation_filter") %>>%
    po("colapply", applicator = as.numeric, affect_columns = selector_type(c("integer", "logical", "numeric")))
} else if (filtering == TRUE || filtering == "minimal" || selecting == TRUE) {
  preprocessing_pipe <- ppl("robustify") %>>%
    po("colapply", applicator = as.numeric, affect_columns = selector_type(c("integer", "logical", "numeric")))
} else if (filtering == "infogain") {
  preprocessing_pipe <- ppl("robustify") %>>%
    po("filter", filter = flt("information_gain"), id = "infogain_filter") %>>%
    po("colapply", applicator = as.numeric, affect_columns = selector_type(c("integer", "logical", "numeric")))
} else if (filtering == FALSE) {
  preprocessing_pipe <- po("nop")
}

# Add scaling for filtered pipelines
if (filtering != FALSE) {
  preprocessing_pipe <- preprocessing_pipe %>>% po("scale", center = TRUE)
}

# Build a SMOTE pipe
smote_pipe <- NULL
if (apply_smote && smote %in% c("smote", "blsmote", "adasyn")) {
  smote_pipe <- switch(smote,
    smote   = po("smote"),
    blsmote = po("blsmote"),
    adasyn  = po("adas"),
    NULL)
}

# Add SMOTE if needed
if (!is.null(smote_pipe)) {
  preprocessing_pipe <- preprocessing_pipe %>>% smote_pipe
}

# Remove lazy_tensor from ALL PipeOps
for (po_name in names(preprocessing_pipe$pipeops)) {
  po <- preprocessing_pipe$pipeops[[po_name]]
  if (!is.null(po$.__enclos_env__$private$.feature_types)) {
    if ("lt" %in% names(po$.__enclos_env__$private$.feature_types)) {
      cat(sprintf("Removing 'lazy_tensor' from %s\n", po_name))
      po$.__enclos_env__$private$.feature_types <-
        po$.__enclos_env__$private$.feature_types[
          names(po$.__enclos_env__$private$.feature_types) != "lt"
        ]
    }
  }
}

cat("\nFinal preprocessing pipeline:\n")
print(preprocessing_pipe)

# Preprocessing parameter search space
preproc_params <- list()

if (filtering == "varcor") {
  preproc_params <- c(preproc_params, list(
    variance_filter.filter.frac = p_dbl(0.5, 1, logscale = TRUE),
    correlation_filter.filter.frac = p_dbl(0.5, 1, logscale = TRUE)
  ))
} else if (filtering == "infogain") {
  preproc_params <- c(preproc_params,
    list(
      infogain_filter.filter.frac = p_dbl(0.2, 1.0, logscale = TRUE)
    )
  )
}

if (!is.null(smote_pipe)) {
  if (smote == "smote") {
    preproc_params <- c(preproc_params, list(
      smote.K = p_int(2, 5),
      smote.dup_size = p_int(1, 5)
    ))
  } else if (smote == "blsmote") {
    preproc_params <- c(preproc_params, list(
      blsmote.K = p_int(2, 5),
      blsmote.dup_size = p_int(1, 5),
      blsmote.C = p_int(1, 5)
    ))
  } else if (smote == "adasyn") {
    preproc_params <- c(preproc_params, list(
      adas.K = p_int(2, 5)
    ))
  }
}
```

#### Feature Selection

```{r feature selection, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Reset computation to sequential
future::plan(sequential)
# Set planned operations in parallel
future::plan(multisession, workers = num_jobs)

# Go FS or EFS
num_col = 100
num_row = 100 #choose a small value to force a simple FS: ensemble FS is computationally demanding

if (selecting) {
  # Set minimum number of features to keep
  if (task_train$ncol < num_col) {
    n_features = 2
  } else {
    n_features = 10
  }
  # Set FS method
  if (task_train$nrow > num_row) {
    fs_method = "simple"
  } else {
    fs_method = "ensemble" # Ensemble Feature Selection is computationally very demanding
  }
  
  # Configure Recursive Feature Elimination (RFE) as the feature selector
  rfe = fs("rfe", n_features = n_features, feature_fraction = 0.8)
  
  # Callbacks (https://mlr-org.com/gallery/technical/2025-01-12-efs/)
  svm_rfe = clbk("mlr3fselect.svm_rfe")
  
  max_nrounds = 500
  internal_ss = ps(nrounds = p_int(
    upper = max_nrounds,
    aggr = function(x)
      as.integer(mean(unlist(x)))
  ))
  xgb_clbk = clbk("mlr3fselect.internal_tuning", internal_search_space = internal_ss)
  
  one_se_clbk = clbk("mlr3fselect.one_se_rule")
  
  # Define a set of learners for ensemble feature selection
  fs_rpart <- lrn("classif.rpart")
  fs_ranger <- lrn("classif.ranger", importance = "permutation")
  fs_svm <- lrn("classif.svm", type = "C-classification", kernel = "linear")
  fs_xgboost <- lrn("classif.xgboost", nrounds = max_nrounds, early_stopping_rounds = 10)
  set_validate(fs_xgboost, 0.2) #validation ratio
  set_threads(fs_ranger, n = ceiling(num_threads / 5))
  set_threads(fs_xgboost, n = ceiling(num_threads / 5))
  
  # Define IDs for each graph learner, same as the callback list in efs, below
  fs_rpart$id <- "rpart"
  fs_ranger$id <- "rf"
  fs_svm$id <- "svm"
  fs_xgboost$id <- "xgboost"
  
  # # Encapsulate with callr and featureless fallback
  # fs_rpart$encapsulate("callr", fallback = lrn("classif.featureless", predict_type = "response"))
  # fs_ranger$encapsulate("callr", fallback = lrn("classif.featureless", predict_type = "response"))
  # fs_svm$encapsulate("callr", fallback = lrn("classif.featureless", predict_type = "response"))
  # fs_xgboost$encapsulate("callr", fallback = lrn("classif.featureless", predict_type = "response"))
  
  # Make a list of graph learners
  # learners = list(fs_rpart, fs_ranger, fs_svm, fs_xgboost)
  learners = list(fs_rpart, fs_ranger, fs_svm, fs_xgboost)
  
  # callbacks = list(
  #     xgboost = list(one_se_clbk, xgb_clbk),
  #     rpart = list(one_se_clbk),
  #     rf = list(one_se_clbk),
  #     svm = list(one_se_clbk, svm_rfe)
  #   )
  
  # Generate a pre-processing pipeline
  robust_pipe <- ppl("robustify") %>>%
    po("colapply",
       applicator = as.numeric,
       affect_columns = selector_type(c("integer", "logical", "numeric")))
  
  # Create new tasks with robustified data
  robust_pipe$train(task_train)
  task_train <- robust_pipe$predict(task_train)[[1]]
  task_test <- robust_pipe$predict(task_test)[[1]]
  
  if (fs_method == "ensemble") {
    # Execute the ensemble feature selection workflow
    efs = ensemble_fselect(
      fselector = rfe,
      task = task_train,
      learners = learners,
      init_resampling = rsmp("subsampling", repeats = 50, ratio = 0.8),
      inner_resampling = rsmp("cv", folds = 5),
      inner_measure = msr("classif.ce"),
      measure = msr("classif.bacc"),
      terminator = trm("none"),
      callbacks = list(
        rpart = list(one_se_clbk),
        rf = list(one_se_clbk),
        svm  = list(one_se_clbk, svm_rfe),
        xgboost  = list(one_se_clbk, xgb_clbk)
      ),
      store_benchmark_result = FALSE
    )
    
    # Summarize and analyze the EFS results
    print(efs)
    head(efs$result)
    
    # Performance scores of different learners
    print(autoplot(efs, type = "performance", theme = theme_minimal(base_size = 14)))
    
    # Number of features selected by each learner
    print(autoplot(efs, type = "n_features", theme = theme_minimal(base_size = 14)))
    
    # Pareto: trade-off between number of features and performance
    print(autoplot(efs, type = "pareto", theme = theme_minimal(base_size = 14)))
    
    # Estimated Pareto front curve by fitting a linear model with the inverse of the number of selected features
    print(
      autoplot(
        efs,
        type = "pareto",
        pareto_front = "estimated",
        theme = theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
      ) + scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") + labs(title = "Estimated Pareto front")
    )
    
    # Identify knee points for feature cutoffs
    kp = efs$knee_points(type = "estimated")
    if (is.na(kp$n_features)) {
      min_feats = median(efs$result$n_features, na.rm = TRUE)
      message("Estimated knee point is NA; using minimum feature count = ",
              min_feats)
      n_feat = min_feats
    } else {
      n_feat = kp$n_features
      message("Estimated knee point: ", n_feat, " features")
    }
    
    # Assess feature selection stability, across all resampling iterations and learners
    global_stab = efs$stability("jaccard", global = TRUE) #assess the stability
    message("Global stability (Jaccard): ", global_stab)
    per_learner_stab = efs$stability("jaccard", global = FALSE) #or per each learner separately
    print(per_learner_stab) #Jaccard index: the higher the better
    autoplot(efs, type = "stability", theme = theme_minimal(base_size = 14)) + scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1") #
    
    # Generate consensus feature ranking based on chosen cutoff, based on approval voting method
    consensus_av = efs$feature_ranking(
      method = "av",
      committee_size = n_feat,
      use_weights = TRUE
    )
    print(consensus_av)
    selected_feats = consensus_av$feature
  } else {
    fs = fsi(
      task = task_train,
      learner = fs_ranger,
      resampling = rsmp("cv", folds = 5),
      measure = msr("classif.bacc"),
      terminator = trm("none")
    )
    
    # Optimize feature selection instance
    rfe$optimize(fs)
    
    # Best feature subset and corresponding performance
    print(as.data.table(fs$result)[, .(features, classif.bacc)])
    
    # Extract best features
    selected_feats = fs$result_feature_set
  }
  
  # Make a new train task with robustified data and selected features
  task_train$select(selected_feats)
  
  # Update task test with selected features
  task_test$select(selected_feats) 
}
```

```{r final look, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
      geom_point() +
      geom_vline(
        xintercept = num_components,
        color = "dodgerblue3",
        linetype = "dashed"
      ) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1, length(
        cumulative_prop_var
      ), 1)) +
      theme_bw() +
      labs(
        title = "Elbow plot of PCA components",
        subtitle = "Reference line: components explaining up to 90% variance",
        x = "Number of components",
        y = "Cumulative proportion of variance explained"
      )
  )
  
  # Get the PCA loading matrix
  loadings <- pca$rotation
  
  # Find the variable with highest absolute loading for each principal component
  variables <- rownames(loadings)  # Get the variable names
  max_loadings <-
    apply(abs(loadings), 2, function(x)
      variables[which.max(x)])
  
  # Output the results
  for (i in 1:ncol(loadings)) {
    cat(paste0("Most important variable for PC", i, ": ", max_loadings[i]),
        "\n")
  }
  
  # t-SNE (on CLR)
  perplexity <- pmin(30, floor((nrow(X_clr) - 1) / 3))  # safe, within 5–30 typical
  ts <- Rtsne(
    X_clr,
    pca = TRUE,
    check_duplicates = FALSE,
    perplexity = perplexity,
    theta = 0.5,
    num_threads = 8 
  )
  
  ts_df <- data.frame(tSNE1 = ts$Y[, 1],
                      tSNE2 = ts$Y[, 2],
                      target = y)
  
  print(
    ggplot(ts_df, aes(tSNE1, tSNE2, fill = target)) +
      geom_point(
        shape = 21,
        size = 5,
        colour = "white",
        stroke = 0.8
      ) +
      scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "turbo", name = "target") +
      theme_bw() +
      labs(title = "t-SNE on CLR-transformed abundances") +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 18),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 14)
      )
  )
}
```

#### Train models

```{r classification, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Tune model hyperparameters via inner cross-validation resampling 

# Reset computation to sequential
future::plan(sequential)
# Set planned operations in parallel
future::plan(multisession, workers = num_jobs)

# Define learners
learners <- list(
  glmnet = lrn("classif.glmnet", predict_type = "prob"),
  kknn = lrn("classif.kknn", predict_type = "prob"),
  lda = lrn("classif.lda", predict_type = "prob"),
  naive_bayes = lrn("classif.naive_bayes", predict_type = "prob"),
  ranger = lrn("classif.ranger", predict_type = "prob"),
  svm = lrn("classif.svm", type = "C-classification", predict_type = "prob"),
  xgboost = lrn("classif.xgboost", predict_type = "prob")
)

if ("mlp" %in% names(methods)) {
  learners <- c(
    learners,
    mlp = lrn(
      "classif.mlp",
      activation = nn_relu,
      loss = t_loss("cross_entropy"),
      device = "auto", #"cpu", "cuda"
      optimizer = t_opt("adamw"),
      measures_valid = msrs(c("classif.bacc", "classif.logloss")),
      measures_train = msrs(c("classif.bacc", "classif.logloss")),
      callbacks = list(t_clbk("history"), t_clbk("progress")),
      validate = NULL,
      eval_freq = 5,
      predict_type = "prob",
      patience = 3,
      min_delta = 0.01,
      num_threads = kfold,
      seed = seed,
      jit_trace = TRUE
    )
  )
} else if ("tabpfn" %in% names(methods)) {
  # Reset computation to sequential
  future::plan(sequential)
  # Ensure no parallel folds on the single GPU
  num_jobs <- 1  
  
  learners <- c(
    learners,
    tabpfn = lrn(
      "classif.tabpfn",
      ignore_pretraining_limits = TRUE,
      device = "auto",
      balance_probabilities = TRUE,
      predict_type = "prob",
      n_jobs = 1
    )
  )
}

# Set up tuning metrics for xgboost
if (dataset_attr == "binary") {
  eval_metrics = c("error", "logloss")
} else if (dataset_attr == "multi-class") {
  eval_metrics = c("merror", "mlogloss")
}

# Count the observation in each target group
min_count <-
  task_train$data() %>% count(target) %>% arrange(n) %>% slice_head(n = 1) %>% pull(n)

# Count the number of features in the train tab
num_feat <- ncol(task_train$data())-1

# Count the number of observations in the train tab
num_obs <- nrow(task_train$data())

for (i in seq_along(methods)) {
  start_time <- Sys.time()
  cat("\n", "##### Method: ", methods[[i]], " ######", "\n")
  cat(" Start time: ", format(start_time, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "\n")
  
  method = names(methods)[i]
  base_learner <- learners[[method]]$clone(deep = TRUE)
  
  # Tuning resampling and fast-tuning override
  if (min_count <= kfold) {
    tuning_resampling <- rsmp("bootstrap", repeats = repeats, ratio = 1)
    # Apply repeated cross-validation if low observation number
  } else if (num_obs >= 500 || method %in% c("mlp", "tabpfn", "xgboost")) {
    tuning_resampling <- rsmp("cv", folds = kfold)
  } else if (num_obs < 500) {
    tuning_resampling <- rsmp("repeated_cv", repeats = repeats, folds = kfold)
  }
  
  # Override fast tuning if not enough features
  if (num_feat < 25 || num_obs < 500)
    fast_tuning = FALSE

  # Build learner + search_space
  if (fast_tuning && method %in% c("glmnet", "kknn", "naive_bayes", "svm")) {
    learner_pipe <- preprocessing_pipe %>>% po("subsample") %>>% base_learner
  } else if (fast_tuning && method == "lda") {
    learner_pipe <- preprocessing_pipe %>>% po("subsample") %>>% po("pca") %>>% base_learner
  } else if (!fast_tuning && method == "lda") {
    learner_pipe <- preprocessing_pipe %>>% po("pca") %>>% base_learner
  } else {
    learner_pipe <- preprocessing_pipe %>>% base_learner
  }
  final_learner <- as_learner(learner_pipe)
  
  # Define search_space
  if (fast_tuning) {
    if (method == "glmnet") {
      learner_params = list(
        subsample.frac = p_dbl(0.1, 1.0, tags = "budget"),
        classif.glmnet.s = p_dbl(1e-4, 1e4, logscale = TRUE),
        classif.glmnet.alpha = p_dbl(0, 1)
      )
    } else if (method == "kknn") {
      learner_params = list(
        subsample.frac = p_dbl(0.1, 1.0, tags = "budget"),
        classif.kknn.k = p_int(1, 50, logscale = TRUE)
      )
    } else if (method == "lda") {
      learner_params = list(
        subsample.frac = p_dbl(0.1, 1.0, tags = "budget"),
        pca.rank. = p_int(lower = 2, upper = min(num_feat, num_obs - 1)),
        classif.lda.method = p_fct(levels = c("moment", "mle", "mve", "t")),
        classif.lda.tol = p_dbl(1e-6, 1e-2, logscale = TRUE),
        classif.lda.nu = p_int(3, 10, depends = quote(classif.lda.method == "t"))
      )
    } else if (method == "mlp") {
      learner_params = list(
        classif.mlp.neurons = p_int(32, 512, tags = "budget"),
        classif.mlp.n_layers = p_int(1, 3),
        classif.mlp.batch_size = p_int(32, 32),
        classif.mlp.epochs = p_int(upper = 100, tags = "internal_tuning", aggr = function(x) as.integer(mean(unlist(x)))),
        classif.mlp.p = p_dbl(0.1, 0.5),
        classif.mlp.opt.lr = p_dbl(1e-4, 1e-1, logscale = TRUE),
        classif.mlp.opt.weight_decay = p_dbl(1e-5, 1e-3, logscale = TRUE)
      )
    } else if (method == "naive_bayes") {
      learner_params = list(
        subsample.frac = p_dbl(0.1, 1.0, tags = "budget"),
        classif.naive_bayes.eps = p_dbl(1e-9, 0.2),
        classif.naive_bayes.laplace = p_dbl(1e-6, 2),
        classif.naive_bayes.threshold = p_dbl(1e-9, 0.1)
      )
    } else if (method == "ranger") {
      learner_params = list(
        classif.ranger.num.trees = p_int(10, 1000, tags = "budget"),
        classif.ranger.mtry.ratio = p_dbl(0.1, 1),
        classif.ranger.sample.fraction = p_dbl(0.1, 1)
      )
    } else if (method == "svm") {
      learner_params = list(
        subsample.frac = p_dbl(0.1, 1.0, tags = "budget"),
        classif.svm.kernel = p_fct(levels = c("polynomial", "radial", "sigmoid")),
        classif.svm.cost = p_dbl(1e-4, 1e4, logscale = TRUE),
        classif.svm.gamma = p_dbl(1e-4, 1e4, logscale = TRUE, depends = quote(classif.svm.kernel %in% c("polynomial", "radial"))),
        classif.svm.degree = p_int(1, 5, depends = quote(classif.svm.kernel == "polynomial"))
      )
    } else if (method == "tabpfn") {
     base_learner$encapsulate("callr", fallback = lrn("classif.featureless", predict_type = "prob"))
      learner_params = list(
        classif.tabpfn.n_estimators = p_int(lower = 4, upper = 4),
        classif.tabpfn.softmax_temperature = p_dbl(lower = 0.9, upper = 0.9)
      )
    } else if (method == "xgboost") {
      base_learner$param_set$set_values(eval_metric = eval_metrics, early_stopping_rounds = 10)
      learner_params = list(
        classif.xgboost.nrounds = p_int(10, 1000, tags = "budget"),
        classif.xgboost.eta = p_dbl(1e-4, 1, logscale = TRUE),
        classif.xgboost.max_depth = p_int(1, 20),
        classif.xgboost.colsample_bytree  = p_dbl(0.1, 1),
        classif.xgboost.colsample_bylevel = p_dbl(0.1, 1),
        classif.xgboost.lambda = p_dbl(1e-3, 1e3, logscale = TRUE),
        classif.xgboost.alpha = p_dbl(1e-3, 1e3, logscale = TRUE),
        classif.xgboost.subsample = p_dbl(0.1, 1)
      )
    } else {
      stop(sprintf("No search space defined for method %s", method))
    }
  } else {
    # Hyperparameter list
    if (method == "glmnet") {
      learner_params = list(
        classif.glmnet.s = p_dbl(1e-4, 1e4, logscale = TRUE),
        classif.glmnet.alpha = p_dbl(0, 1)
      )
    } else if (method == "kknn") {
      learner_params = list(classif.kknn.k = p_int(1, 50, logscale = TRUE))
    } else if (method == "lda") {
      learner_params = list(
        pca.rank. = p_int(lower = 2, upper = min(num_feat, num_obs - 1)),
        classif.lda.method = p_fct(levels = c("moment", "mle", "mve", "t")),
        classif.lda.tol = p_dbl(1e-6, 1e-2, logscale = TRUE),
        classif.lda.nu = p_int(3, 10, depends = quote(classif.lda.method == "t"))
      )
    } else if (method == "mlp") {
      learner_params = list(
        classif.mlp.n_layers = p_int(1, 3),
        
        l1 = p_int(32, 512),
        l2 = p_int(32, 512),
        l3 = p_int(32, 512),
        
        .extra_trafo = function(x, ps) {
          nL <- x[["classif.mlp.n_layers"]]
          widths <- as.integer(unlist(x[c("l1", "l2", "l3")], use.names = FALSE))
          x[["classif.mlp.neurons"]] <- widths[seq_len(nL)]
          x[c("classif.mlp.n_layers", "l1", "l2", "l3")] <- NULL
          x
        },
        
        classif.mlp.epochs = p_int(upper = 1000, tags = "internal_tuning", aggr = function(x) as.integer(mean(unlist(x)))),
        classif.mlp.batch_size = p_int(16, 64, tags = "budget"),
        classif.mlp.p = p_dbl(0.1, 0.5),
        classif.mlp.opt.lr = p_dbl(1e-4, 1e-1, logscale = TRUE),
        classif.mlp.opt.weight_decay = p_dbl(1e-5, 1e-3, logscale = TRUE)
      )
    } else if (method == "naive_bayes") {
      learner_params = list(
        classif.naive_bayes.eps = p_dbl(1e-9, 0.2),
        classif.naive_bayes.laplace = p_dbl(1e-6, 2),
        classif.naive_bayes.threshold = p_dbl(1e-9, 0.1)
      )
    } else if (method == "ranger") {
      learner_params = list(
        classif.ranger.num.trees = p_int(10, 1000, tags = "budget"),
        classif.ranger.mtry.ratio = p_dbl(0.1, 1),
        classif.ranger.sample.fraction = p_dbl(0.1, 1)
      )
    } else if (method == "svm") {
      learner_params = list(
        classif.svm.kernel = p_fct(levels = c("polynomial", "radial", "sigmoid")),
        classif.svm.cost = p_dbl(1e-4, 1e4, logscale = TRUE),
        classif.svm.gamma = p_dbl(1e-4, 1e4, logscale = TRUE, depends = quote(classif.svm.kernel %in% c("polynomial", "radial"))),
        classif.svm.degree  = p_int(1, 5, depends = quote(classif.svm.kernel == "polynomial"))
      )
    } else if (method == "tabpfn") {
      base_learner$encapsulate("callr", fallback = lrn("classif.featureless", predict_type = "prob"))
      learner_params = list(
        classif.tabpfn.n_estimators = p_int(lower = 4, upper = 4),
        classif.tabpfn.softmax_temperature = p_dbl(lower = 0.9, upper = 0.9)
      )
      } else if (method == "xgboost") {
      base_learner$param_set$set_values(eval_metric = eval_metrics, early_stopping_rounds = 10)
      learner_params = list(
        classif.xgboost.nrounds = p_int(10, 1000, tags = "budget"),
        classif.xgboost.eta = p_dbl(1e-4, 1, logscale = TRUE),
        classif.xgboost.max_depth = p_int(1, 20),
        classif.xgboost.colsample_bytree = p_dbl(0.1, 1),
        classif.xgboost.colsample_bylevel = p_dbl(0.1, 1),
        classif.xgboost.lambda = p_dbl(1e-3, 1e3, logscale = TRUE),
        classif.xgboost.alpha = p_dbl(1e-3, 1e3, logscale = TRUE),
        classif.xgboost.subsample = p_dbl(0.1, 1)
      )
    } else {
      stop(sprintf("No search space defined for method %s", method))
    }
  }

  # Final joint search space for AutoTuner
  search_space = do.call(ps, c(preproc_params, learner_params))
  
  if (!fast_tuning && method == "mlp") {
    search_space$add_dep("l2", on = "classif.mlp.n_layers", CondAnyOf$new(2:3))
    search_space$add_dep("l3", on = "classif.mlp.n_layers", CondEqual$new(3))
  }
  
  print(search_space)
  
  # Customized final learner pipeline
  final_learner$id <- method
  final_learner$graph$keep_results = TRUE
  if (method %in% c("mlp", "xgboost")) set_validate(final_learner, 0.2)
  if (method %in% c("ranger", "xgboost")) set_threads(final_learner, n = ceiling(num_threads / num_jobs))
  # if (method %in% c("ranger", "xgboost")) set_threads(final_learner, n = 1)
  
  # Encapsulate with callr and featureless fallback
  if (learner_fallback && method != "tabpfn") {
    final_learner$encapsulate("callr", fallback = lrn("classif.featureless", predict_type = "prob"))
    }
  
  # Tuner & Terminator setup
  if (fast_tuning) {
    tuner <- switch(method,
      glmnet = tnr("successive_halving", eta = 2, repetitions = 3),
      kknn = tnr("successive_halving", eta = 2, repetitions = 3),
      lda = tnr("successive_halving", eta = 2, repetitions = 3),
      mlp = tnr("hyperband", eta = 2, repetitions = 1),
      naive_bayes = tnr("successive_halving", eta = 2, repetitions = 3),
      svm = tnr("successive_halving", eta = 2, repetitions = 3),
      tabpfn = tnr("grid_search", resolution = 3, batch_size = floor(num_threads/num_jobs)),
      ranger = tnr("hyperband", eta = 2, repetitions = 1),
      xgboost = tnr("hyperband", eta = 3, repetitions = 1)
    )
  } else {
    tuner <- switch(
      method,
      glmnet = tnr("grid_search", resolution = 5, batch_size = floor(num_threads/num_jobs)),
      kknn = tnr("grid_search", resolution = 5, batch_size = floor(num_threads/num_jobs)),
      lda = tnr("grid_search", resolution = 5, batch_size = floor(num_threads/num_jobs)),
      mlp = tnr("hyperband", eta = 2, repetitions = 3),
      naive_bayes = tnr("grid_search", resolution = 5, batch_size = floor(num_threads/num_jobs)),
      svm = tnr("grid_search", resolution = 5, batch_size = floor(num_threads/num_jobs)),
      tabpfn = tnr("grid_search", resolution = 3, batch_size = floor(num_threads/num_jobs)),
      ranger = tnr("hyperband", eta = 2, repetitions = 3),
      xgboost = tnr("hyperband", eta = 2, repetitions = 3)
    )
  }
  
  terminator <- switch(
    method,
    glmnet = trm("none"),
    kknn = trm("none"),
    lda = trm("none"),
    mlp = trm("evals", n_evals = 250 / kfold),
    naive_bayes = trm("none"),
    svm = trm("run_time", secs = 60 * term_min),
    tabpfn = trm("combo", list(
      trm("evals", n_evals = 50 / kfold),
      trm("run_time", secs = 60 * term_min)
    ), any = TRUE),
    ranger = trm("combo", list(
      trm("evals", n_evals = 250 / kfold),
      trm("run_time", secs = 60 * term_min)
    ), any = TRUE),
    xgboost = trm("none")
  )
    
  # File handling
    instance_file <- file.path(save_dir, paste0(method, "_tuned_instance.rds"))
    learner_file  <- file.path(save_dir, paste0(method, "_tuned_learner.rds"))
    
    if (file.exists(instance_file)) {
      instance <- readRDS(instance_file)
      if (instance$is_terminated && file.exists(learner_file)) {
        next
      } else {
        cat("Tune learner:", method, "\n")
      }
    } else {
      instance <- ti(
        task_train,
        final_learner,
        tuning_resampling,
        msrs(train_measures),
        terminator,
        search_space = search_space,
        store_benchmark_result = TRUE,
        store_models = FALSE
      )
      tuner$optimize(instance)
      saveRDS(instance, instance_file)
    }
    
    results <- instance$archive$data
    if (nrow(results) > 0) {
      results <- results[order(-results$classif.bacc, results$classif.logloss), ]
      best_idx <- results$uhash[1]
      if (!is.na(best_idx)) {
        best_params <- instance$result_learner_param_vals[[which(results$uhash == best_idx)]]
        final_learner$param_set$values <- as.list(best_params)
        final_learner$train(task_train)
        # Handle a mlr3torch
        if (method == "mlp") {
          final_learner$marshal()
          # Inspect
          torch_dt <- as.data.table(instance$archive)
          torch_best <- instance$archive$best()
          cat(
            "Best n_layers:",
            length(torch_best$x_domain[[1]]$classif.mlp.neurons),
            "\n",
            "Best neurons: ",
            paste(torch_best$x_domain[[1]]$classif.mlp.neurons, collapse = "-"),
            "\n",
            "Balanced accuracy:",
            mean(torch_best$classif.bacc),
            "\n",
            "Logloss:",
            mean(torch_best$classif.logloss),
            "\n"
          )
        }
        saveRDS(final_learner, learner_file)
      } else {
        warning("No valid best model found for", method)
      }
    } else {
      warning("Tuning results empty for", method)
    }
    
    assign(paste(method, "tuned", "learner", sep = "_"), final_learner)
  
  end_time <- Sys.time()
  cat(" End time:", format(end_time, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "\n")
  time_diff <- difftime(end_time, start_time, units = "secs")
  if (time_diff < 60) {
    cat(" Time taken for algorithm", method, ":", time_diff, "seconds\n")
  } else {
    cat(" Time taken for algorithm", method, ":", round(time_diff / 60, 2), "minutes\n")
  }
}
```

#### Benchmark

```{r benchmarking, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# Define measure used for plotting and evaluation
measure = c('accuracy' = "classif.acc")

# Utility function to inspect final features and class distribution after preprocessing
get_final_preproc_summary <- function(graph_learner, after = smote) {
  stopifnot(inherits(graph_learner, "GraphLearner"))
  
  po_out <- graph_learner$graph_model$pipeops[[after]]$.result$output
  features_summary <- NULL
  class_counts <- NULL
  
  if (is.null(po_out) || !("Task" %in% class(po_out))) {
    warning(
      sprintf(
        "The specified pipeop '%s' has no valid Task output. Was the graph learner trained with fallback encapsulation or did training fail? Only filter summary will be shown.",
        after
      )
    )
    # Always print filter summary regardless of po_out
    pipeops_out <- graph_learner$graph_model$pipeops
    filter_summary <- data.frame(
      filter_id = character(),
      considered = integer(),
      selected = integer(),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    features_per_filter <- list()
    for (id in names(pipeops_out)) {
      po = pipeops_out[[id]]
      if (inherits(po, "PipeOpFilter")) {
        considered = length(po$state$affected_cols)
        selected   = length(po$state$features)
        filter_summary <- rbind(
          filter_summary,
          data.frame(
            filter_id = id,
            considered = considered,
            selected = selected,
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE
          )
        )
        features_per_filter[[id]] <- po$state$features
      }
    }
    print(filter_summary)
    # Optionally save as above
    # for (id in names(features_per_filter)) {
    #   writeLines(features_per_filter[[id]], paste0("features_survived_", id, ".txt"))
    # }
    return(list(
      features = NA,
      n_features = NA,
      class_distribution = NA,
      filter_summary = filter_summary,
      features_per_filter = features_per_filter
    ))
  }
  
  # If po_out is a Task, proceed as normal
  features_summary <- po_out$feature_names
  class_data <- po_out$data(cols = "target")
  class_counts <- if ("target" %in% colnames(class_data)) table(class_data$target) else NA
  
  list(
    features = features_summary,
    n_features = length(features_summary),
    class_distribution = class_counts
  )
}

# Reset computation to sequential
future::plan(sequential)
# Set planned operations in parallel
future::plan(multisession, workers = num_jobs)

# Select resampling strategy depending on class size
if (min_count <= kfold) {
  benchmark_resampling <- rsmp("bootstrap", repeats = 10, ratio = 1)
} else {

  # benchmark_resampling <- rsmp("repeated_cv", repeats = repeats, folds = kfold)
}

# Import tuned learners
learners_best <- list()
for (method in names(methods)) {
  obj_name <- paste(method, "tuned", "learner", sep = "_")
  learner_name <- paste0(method, "_tuned_learner.rds")
  learner_path <- file.path(save_dir, learner_name)
  
  # First, try to get tuned learners the environment
  if (exists(obj_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
    cat("\nMethod:", method, "| found in memory (", obj_name, ")\n")
    learner <- get(obj_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  } else if (file.exists(learner_path)) {
    cat("\nMethod:", method, "->", learner_path, "| file exists, loading from disk\n")
    learner <- tryCatch(
      readRDS(learner_path),
      error = function(e) {
        cat("  !!! Error loading", learner_name, ":", e$message, "\n")
        return(NULL)
      }
    )
    if (is.null(learner)) next
  } else {
    cat("\nMethod:", method, "| SKIP: No tuned model found in memory or disk.\n")
    next
  }
  
  # Import an mlr3torch learner needs special care
  learner$unmarshal()
  
  # Set threads back to 1 internally
  learner <- tryCatch(
    set_threads(learner, n = 1),
    error = function(e) {
      cat("  !!! Error setting threads for", method, ":", e$message, "\n")
      return(NULL)
    }
  )
  if (is.null(learner)) next

  cat("  --> Training learner:", method, "\n")
  tryCatch({
    learner$train(task_train)
    learners_best[[method]] <- learner
    cat("  --> SUCCESS: Trained and stored learner for", method, "\n")
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("Error training", method, ":", e$message, "\n")
  })
}

# Run pipeline summaries, referencing the patched learners_best
for (method in names(learners_best)) {
  summary <- suppressWarnings(get_final_preproc_summary(learners_best[[method]]))
  if (!is.null(summary)) {
    cat(sprintf("\n--- [%s] ---\n", method))
    if (!is.na(summary$n_features)) {
      cat(sprintf("Final features (%d):\n", summary$n_features))
      print(summary$features)
      cat("Class distribution:\n")
      print(summary$class_distribution)
    } else {
      cat("No Task output; see filter summary above.\n")
    }
  }
}

# Run benchmark and report time
start_time <- Sys.time()
cat(" Start time: ", format(start_time, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "\n")

bmr <- benchmark(design = benchmark_grid(task_train, learners_best, benchmark_resampling))

end_time <- Sys.time()
cat(" End time: ", format(end_time, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "\n")

# Report duration
time_diff <- difftime(end_time, start_time, units = "secs")
if (time_diff < 60) {
  cat(" Time taken for benchmarking:", time_diff, " seconds\n")
} else {
  time_diff <- difftime(end_time, start_time, units = "mins")
  cat(" Time taken for benchmarking: ", time_diff, " minutes\n")
}

# Plot model performance

  )

# Summarize benchmark results

bench_df %<>%
  mutate(
    method = case_when(
        stringr::str_detect(learner_id, "glmnet") ~ "GLM elastic net",
        stringr::str_detect(learner_id, "kknn") ~ "K-Nearest Neighbor",
        stringr::str_detect(learner_id, "lda") ~ "Linear Discriminant Analysis",
        stringr::str_detect(learner_id, "mlp") ~ "Multi-layer Perceptron",
        stringr::str_detect(learner_id, "naive_bayes") ~ "Naive Bayes",
        stringr::str_detect(learner_id, "ranger") ~ "Random Forest",
        stringr::str_detect(learner_id, "svm") ~ "Support Vector Machine",
        stringr::str_detect(learner_id, "tabpfn") ~ "TabPFN",
        stringr::str_detect(learner_id, "xgboost") ~ "XGBoost",

      )
  ) %>%
  relocate(tail(names(.), 1), .before = names(.)[1]) %>%

# Average fold-wise predictions

# Flatten predictionClassif objects into one tibble

  map_dfr(~ as.data.table(.x) %>% as_tibble())

# Inspect available probability columns
prob_cols <- grep("^prob\\.", names(all_preds), value = TRUE)

# Binary classification: compute probability for the positive class
if (length(prob_cols) == 2) {
  positive_col <- paste0("prob.", positive_class)
  avg_preds <- all_preds %>%
    group_by(row_ids) %>%
    summarise(
      prob_positive = mean(.data[[positive_col]]),
      truth = first(truth),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      response = if_else(prob_positive >= 0.5, positive_class, setdiff(levels(truth), positive_class)),
      response = factor(response, levels = levels(truth)),
      correct = response == truth
    )
} else {
  # Multiclass classification: just use majority predicted class
  avg_preds <- all_preds %>%
    group_by(row_ids) %>%
    summarise(
      response = names(which.max(colMeans(across(all_of(prob_cols))))),
      truth = first(truth),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      response = sub("prob\\.", "", response),
      response = factor(response, levels = levels(truth)),
      correct = response == truth
    )
}

# Final class-Level summary

  group_by(truth) %>%
  summarise(
    correct = sum(correct),
    incorrect = n() - sum(correct),

    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

#### Prediction

```{r prediction, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# Initialize 'predictions' as an empty list
predictions <- list()

for (method in names(methods)) {
  # 1) prefer the already trained object from learners_best
  best_model <- learners_best[[method]]

  # 2) if missing, load from disk and prepare
  if (is.null(best_model)) {
    path <- file.path(save_dir, paste0(method, "_tuned_learner.rds"))
    if (!file.exists(path)) {
      cat("SKIP:", method, "- no tuned learner found in memory or disk\n")
      next
    }
    best_model <- readRDS(path)
    # torch/graph models may be marshaled
    if ("unmarshal" %in% names(best_model)) {
      try(best_model$unmarshal(), silent = TRUE)
    }
    # re-train on train split to ensure fitted state
    best_model$train(task_train)
  }

  # 3) predict on test
  pred <- best_model$predict(task_test)
  predictions[[method]] <- pred

  # 4) print test score
  sc <- pred$score(msr("classif.acc"))
  cat("\n classif.acc of", methods[[method]], ":", round(sc, 2), "\n")

  # 5) print and export per-method TRUE/FALSE predicted values
  pred_tab <- data.frame(truth = pred$truth, response = pred$response, pred$prob)
  pred_tab$match <- ifelse(pred_tab$truth == pred_tab$response, "TRUE", "FALSE")
  print(pred_tab %>%
        count(match) %>%
        mutate(ratio = round(n / sum(n), 2)))
  assign(paste(method, "test", "predict", sep = "_"), pred_tab)
  pred_df <- pred$score(measures = lapply(bmr_measures, msr))
  assign(paste(method, "pred", "df", sep = "_"), pred_df)
}

# Create pred_df with learners performance across multiple metrics on the test dataset. The output is conceptually the same as bench_df 
gather_pred_performance <- function(env = .GlobalEnv) {
  # Find all *_pred_df objects in the environment
  pred_df_names <- ls(envir = env, pattern = "_pred_df$")
  if (length(pred_df_names) == 0)
    stop("No *_pred_df objects found.")
  
  # For each, convert the named vector to a 1-row data.frame and add method column
  pred_list <- lapply(pred_df_names, function(obj_name) {
    x <- get(obj_name, envir = env)
    # If not a data.frame, convert
    if (!is.data.frame(x))
      x <- as.data.frame(t(x))
    # Extract method name (remove _pred_df suffix)
    x$method <- sub("_pred_df$", "", obj_name)
    x
  })

  # Merge all into a single data.frame
  pred_df <- bind_rows(pred_list)
  
  # Rename measures as in bench_df and harmonize column names/order
  pred_df <- pred_df %>%
    relocate(method) %>%
    rename_with(
      ~ case_when(
        .x == "classif.acc" ~ "accuracy",
        .x == "classif.bacc" ~ "balanced accuracy",
        .x == "classif.precision" ~ "precision",
        .x == "classif.recall" ~ "recall",
        .x == "classif.specificity" ~ "specificity",
        .x == "classif.fbeta" ~ "f1",
        .x == "classif.auc" ~ "auc",
        .x == "classif.prauc" ~ "pr auc",
        .x == "classif.logloss" ~ "logloss",
        TRUE ~ .x
      )
    ) %>%
    rename(learner_id = method) %>%
    mutate(
      method = case_when(
        stringr::str_detect(learner_id, "glmnet") ~ "GLM elastic net",
        stringr::str_detect(learner_id, "kknn") ~ "K-Nearest Neighbor",
        stringr::str_detect(learner_id, "lda") ~ "Linear Discriminant Analysis",
        stringr::str_detect(learner_id, "mlp") ~ "Multi-layer Perceptron",
        stringr::str_detect(learner_id, "naive_bayes") ~ "Naive Bayes",
        stringr::str_detect(learner_id, "ranger") ~ "Random Forest",
        stringr::str_detect(learner_id, "svm") ~ "Support Vector Machine",
        stringr::str_detect(learner_id, "tabpfn") ~ "TabPFN",
        stringr::str_detect(learner_id, "xgboost") ~ "XGBoost",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 4)))
  
  # If bench_df is provided, use its column order
  if (!is.null(bench_df)) {
    # Only reorder columns present in pred_df
    common_cols <- intersect(names(bench_df), names(pred_df))
    pred_df <- pred_df[, common_cols]
  }
  
  return(pred_df)
}

pred_df <- gather_pred_performance()
print(pred_df)

# Aggregate all test-set prediction tables and visualize class-wise accuracy by method
gather_pred_tabs <- function(env = .GlobalEnv) {
  objs <- ls(envir = env, pattern = "_test_predict$")
  if (!length(objs)) stop("No *_test_predict objects found.")
  out <- lapply(objs, function(nm) {
    df <- get(nm, envir = env)
    df$learner_id <- sub("_test_predict$", "", nm)
    df
  }) %>% bind_rows()
  
  out %>% 
    mutate(
      method = case_when(
        str_detect(learner_id, "glmnet") ~ "GLM elastic net",
        str_detect(learner_id, "kknn") ~ "K-Nearest Neighbor",
        str_detect(learner_id, "lda") ~ "Linear Discriminant Analysis",
        str_detect(learner_id, "mlp") ~ "Multi-layer Perceptron",
        str_detect(learner_id, "naive_bayes") ~ "Naive Bayes",
        str_detect(learner_id, "ranger") ~ "Random Forest",
        str_detect(learner_id, "svm") ~ "Support Vector Machine",
        str_detect(learner_id, "tabpfn") ~ "TabPFN",
        str_detect(learner_id, "xgboost") ~ "XGBoost",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      )
    )
}
```

#### Feature importance

```{r importance, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# Use the best accuracy model
method <- best_model_id
n_samples_shap <- 100 #for speed
n_features <- 10  #top features to show

# Taxon name simplifier
parse_taxon_name <- function(name) {
  parsed_name <- stringr::str_extract(name, "(?<=_s__).*")
  parsed_name <- stringr::str_replace_all(parsed_name, "_t__", "_")
  parsed_name
}

# Extract training data
temp_dat  <- task_train$data()
temp_tab  <- temp_dat %>% dplyr::select(-target) %>% as.data.frame()
temp_targ <- task_train$data()$target

# Simplify feature names
original_names   <- colnames(temp_tab)
simplified_names <- vapply(original_names, parse_taxon_name, FUN.VALUE = character(1))
name_mapping     <- setNames(simplified_names, original_names)

# Get the tuned learner
imodel <- get(paste(method, "tuned", "learner", sep = "_"))

# iml Predictor
temp_pred <- Predictor$new(
  model = imodel,
  data  = temp_tab,
  y     = temp_targ,
  type  = "prob"
)

# Parallel plan (optional)
future::plan(sequential)
if (!method %in% c("mlp", "tabpfn"))
  future::plan(future::multisession, workers = num_threads)

# SHAP importance

# Subsample samples
n_samples_shap <- min(n_samples_shap, nrow(temp_tab))
idx <- sample.int(nrow(temp_tab), n_samples_shap)
temp_tab_small <- temp_tab[idx, , drop = FALSE]

# Compute SHAP for the selected samples
shap_list <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(temp_tab_small)), function(i) {
  s <- Shapley$new(temp_pred, x.interest = temp_tab_small[i, , drop = FALSE])
  s$results %>% dplyr::mutate(sample_id = idx[i])
})

shap_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(shap_list)

# Global SHAP importance (mean |phi|) + top-N
shap_agg <- shap_all %>%
  dplyr::group_by(feature) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(mean_abs_phi = mean(abs(phi)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(feature_pretty = dplyr::recode(feature, !!!name_mapping)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(mean_abs_phi)) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = n_features)

# Plot 1: global SHAP importance
plot_global <- ggplot(shap_agg, aes(x = reorder(feature_pretty, mean_abs_phi), y = mean_abs_phi)) +
  geom_col(fill = "royalblue3") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title    = paste("Top", n_features, "features by mean SHAP"),
    subtitle = paste(n_samples_shap, "samples used"),
    x        = "Feature (taxon)",
    y        = "Mean SHAP"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14)
  )

print(plot_global)

# Class-specific SHAP (direction)
class_contrib <- shap_all %>%
  dplyr::group_by(feature, class) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_phi     = mean(phi),
    mean_abs_phi = mean(abs(phi)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(feature_pretty = dplyr::recode(feature, !!!name_mapping)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(class = str_replace_all(class, "_", " "))

# Keep only the top-N features
class_contrib_top <- class_contrib %>%
  dplyr::filter(feature %in% shap_agg$feature)

classes <- sort(unique(class_contrib$class))

if (length(classes) == 2L) {
  ref <- classes[1]
  oth <- classes[2]
  
  class_plot <- class_contrib_top %>%
    dplyr::filter(class == ref) %>%
    ggplot(aes(
      x = reorder(feature_pretty, mean_phi),
      y = mean_phi,
      fill = mean_phi > 0
    )) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("TRUE" = "#1f78b4", "FALSE" = "#e31a1c"),
      labels = c("Decreases P(ref)", "Increases P(ref)")
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(
      title = paste("Class-specific SHAP (Reference:", ref, ")"),
      subtitle = paste(n_samples_shap, "samples and", n_features, "features used"),
      x = "Feature (Simplified species name)",
      y = paste("Mean SHAP for", ref),
      fill = "Effect direction"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14)
  )
  
  print(class_plot)
  
} else {
  # Multiclass case
  # Determine a valid x position (top feature after reorder)
  x_pos <- shap_agg$feature_pretty[1]
  
  class_plot <- ggplot(class_contrib_top, aes(
    x = reorder(feature_pretty, mean_abs_phi),
    y = mean_phi,
    fill = class
  )) +
    scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "turbo", name = "target") +
    geom_col(position = "dodge") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(
      title = paste("Class-specific SHAP contributions"),
      subtitle = paste(n_samples_shap, "samples and", n_features, "features used"),
      x = "Feature (taxon)",
      y = "Mean SHAP value (left = decreases P(class), right = increases P(class))"
    ) +
    
    # RIGHT side annotation
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = x_pos,
      y = max(class_contrib_top$mean_phi, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.7,
      label = "→ increases probability",
      hjust = -0.1,
      vjust = -0.5,
      color = "darkgreen",
      size = 6
    ) +
    
    # LEFT side annotation
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = x_pos,
      y = min(class_contrib_top$mean_phi, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.7,
      label = "← decreases probability",
      hjust = 1.1,
      vjust = -0.5,
      color = "darkred",
      size = 6
    ) +
    
    expand_limits(y = c(
      min(class_contrib_top$mean_phi, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.5,
      max(class_contrib_top$mean_phi, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.5
    )) +
    
        theme_minimal() +
        
        theme(
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 18),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 14)
        )
      
      print(class_plot)
}
```
